#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int x, y;
    Point(int x, int y) : x(x), y(y) {}
};

class CFA {
public:
    void execute() {
        int n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;
        if (n > m) swap(n, m);

        if (n == 1) {
            m--;
            static const int pattern[] = {0, 0, 0, 2, 4, 6};
            long long result = (m / 6) * 6 + pattern[m % 6];
            printLine(result);
            return;
        } else if (n == 2) {
            if (m < 20) {
                printLine(bruteforce(n, m));
            } else {
                printLine(1LL * n * m);
            }
            return;
        } else if (n == 3) {
            if (m < 20) {
                printLine(bruteforce(n, m));
            } else {
                long long res = 1LL * n * m;
                if (res % 2 != 0) res--;
                printLine(res);
            }
            return;
        }

        long long totalCells = (long long) n * m;
        if (totalCells % 2 != 0) totalCells--;
        printLine(totalCells);
    }

private:
    int bruteforce(int n, int m) {
        std::vector<Point> evenPoints, oddPoints;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                    evenPoints.emplace_back(i, j);
                } else {
                    oddPoints.emplace_back(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        int sizeEven = (int)evenPoints.size();
        int sizeOdd = (int)oddPoints.size();
        std::vector<std::vector<bool>> adjacency(sizeEven, std::vector<bool>(sizeOdd, false));

        for (int i = 0; i < sizeEven; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeOdd; j++) {
                int dist = std::abs(evenPoints[i].x - oddPoints[j].x) + std::abs(evenPoints[i].y - oddPoints[j].y);
                if (dist == 3) {
                    adjacency[i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        return 2 * maxMatching(adjacency);
    }

    int maxMatching(const std::vector<std::vector<bool>>& graph) {
        int n1 = (int)graph.size();
        int n2 = n1 > 0 ? (int)graph[0].size() : 0;
        std::vector<int> match(n2, -1);
        int matchCount = 0;
        for (int u = 0; u < n1; u++) {
            std::vector<bool> visited(n1, false);
            if (dfsMatch(u, graph, match, visited))
                matchCount++;
        }
        return matchCount;
    }

    bool dfsMatch(int u, const std::vector<std::vector<bool>>& g, std::vector<int>& match, std::vector<bool>& visited) {
        visited[u] = true;
        for (int v = 0; v < (int)match.size(); v++) {
            if (g[u][v] && (match[v] == -1 || (!visited[match[v]] && dfsMatch(match[v], g, match, visited)))) {
                match[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    void printLine(long long o) {
        std::cout << o << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    CFA cfa;
    cfa.execute();
    return 0;
}
